title: Spec Scenario Catalog File
description: Schema for one feature catalog file under test/scenarios/catalog/. Each file enumerates RFC-bound scenario rows that test/scenarios/<feature>_test.go binds to 1:1.

feature.description: kebab-or-snake-case slug; MUST equal the filename without the .yaml extension.

prefix.description: Uppercase identifier prefix used by all rows in this file. MUST be unique across every catalog file.

specs.description: Spec citations covering the feature as a whole (RFC numbers, OIDC chapters, draft titles).

description.description: Optional multi-line context for the file.

shape_exempt_reason.description: Why this file is right to demand only that things appear. Set it to exempt the file from the shape gate, which otherwise fails a file whose in-scope rows say nothing about values, ordering or identity. A file that later grows a non-presence row must drop the exemption.

id.description: Stable scenario ID. Format: <prefix>(-<sub_prefix>)*-<NNN>. The leading <prefix> MUST equal the file's prefix; sub-prefixes are free uppercase tokens.

severity.description: P0 = security/spec compliance. P1 = correctness/interop. P2 = error shape/UX/observability.

spec.description: Specific RFC clause / OIDC §section the row binds to.

behaviour.description: Plain-English expected behaviour. Imperative voice, present tense. Avoid implementation-specific names.

status.description: active = a TestScenario_<id>_* function asserts the behaviour. pending = catalog row exists, no test yet (or t.Skip placeholder). out-of-scope = intentional exclusion (requires out_of_scope_reason).

shape.description: What the row demands. presence = something appears or is absent. value = a particular value, or a relationship between values. order = a sequence (what happens before what, what is consumed once). identity = which principal, client, grant or session the thing refers to. Optional: the shape gate infers a shape from the behaviour text and only ever infers upward, out of presence, so declare this only when the prose does not read the way the inference expects.

cross_refs.description: References to rows in other catalog files. Format: <feature>#<ID>.

covered_by.description: Names the test that asserts this row when the assertion cannot live in the scenario suite. Format: <package path>.<TestFunc>. Only valid when status == active. The coverage gate resolves the name with `go test -list`, so a rename on the other side fails the build.

notes.description: Freeform context for reviewers (e.g. blocked-on, special fixture needs).

out_of_scope_reason.description: Required when status == out-of-scope. Brief justification, may reference an ADR.
